tldr: On Oct 16, coverage framed Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 as a name without a released model, and one report said a new Chinese export-license requirement for large AI models could affect it. On Oct 23, reports said it was being readied for release after Arena testing.
whats_new: On Oct 28, NEAR Protocol announced Kimi K3.1 Pro on its AI Cloud, the first third-party hosting reported since Moonshot restored Pro quotas on Oct 27.
why_it_matters: A third-party host gives a possible second route to Kimi K3.1 Pro outside Moonshot's quota-limited API, but its pricing, limits and data terms are not in the report.

status.detail: Moonshot restored Pro quotas after an apology; NEAR AI Cloud now lists the model, and a stable quota policy has not been reported.

beats.headline: Kimi K3.1 discussed before any model ships; export-license rule flagged
beats.summary: Oct 16 items: a name-only comparison piece and a report on a Chinese export-license requirement for new large AI models.

beats.headline: Release prep after Arena testing, plus head-to-head comparison
beats.summary: Oct 23 items: release-readiness report and a comparison with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.

beats.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro launches as a 3T-parameter flagship
beats.summary: Oct 24 items: SiliconANGLE launch report and a Latent Space issue citing open weights and a Pro Highspeed API.

beats.headline: Moonshot resets Pro quotas after complaints, then apologises and restores them
beats.summary: Oct 26-27 items: quota reset after user complaints, then an apology and restored quotas.

beats.headline: NEAR Protocol lists Kimi K3.1 Pro on its AI Cloud
beats.summary: Oct 28: a crypto-news report of third-party hosting after the quota apology.

open_questions: Do independent evals confirm the Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra comparison claims?
Does the reported Chinese export-license requirement restrict Kimi K3.1 availability?
Does Moonshot publish a stable quota policy for Kimi K3.1 Pro after restoring quotas?
What pricing, rate limits and data-handling terms does NEAR AI Cloud publish for Kimi K3.1 Pro?
take_for_builders: Rerun your own evals on Kimi K3.1 Pro before routing traffic, keep a fallback model until Moonshot publishes stable quota limits, and compare NEAR's terms once published before using it as a second route.
